info.title: Agent Gateway API
info.description:
Agent Gateway lets approved AI assistants, automation tools, and external apps use selected Relewise capabilities through My Relewise without sharing Dataset API Keys.

Authenticate with a My Relewise Personal Access Token as a bearer token. Dataset-scoped operations also check the token's Dataset access, the Dataset Access Policy, enabled Agent Gateway areas, and the user's My Relewise permissions.

Agent Gateway is designed for AI agents as well as developers. When Dataset-specific values are unknown, use the available discovery operations instead of guessing identifiers, languages, currencies, Data Keys, or Classification Values. Operation descriptions identify intended use, alternatives, and side effects.

For setup, access control, and security details, read the Agent Gateway documentation.

The raw OpenAPI document is available at openapi/v1.json.

get.description: Returns identifying and operational details about the requested Dataset, its License, and its effective Agent Gateway access policy. Use CoreGetDatasetMetadata instead to discover languages, currencies, Data Keys, Classification Values, and other Dataset-specific request vocabulary. This operation is read-only.

parameters.name: datasetId
parameters.description: Dataset ID that scopes the request. The Personal Access Token must have access to this Dataset, and the Dataset Access Policy must allow the requested Agent Gateway operation.

get.description: Discovers Dataset-specific languages, currencies, and schema information needed to construct subsequent requests. It can include available Data Keys, nested Data Keys, Variant specification keys, Classification Values, and company metadata. Use this operation when required Dataset-specific field names or values are unknown; Data Key names are case-sensitive. This operation is read-only.

value.description: Constant multiplier value. Values above one boost and values between zero and one bury matching entities.

endsAt.description: UTC date and time when the rule stops being active, or null when the schedule has no upper time bound.
